AdMarkers.description_en:
The ad markers supported in the playlist. Valid values:
NONE: removes ad markers.
DATE_RANGE: uses the EXT-X-DATERANGE tag defined in the HLS specification. This value is available when the endpoint protocol is HLS/HLS_CMAF.
XML: uses the XML ad markers defined in the DASH specification. This value is available when the endpoint protocol is DASH
AdMarkers.description_zh:
播放清单中支持的广告标记。
NONE：去除广告标记
DATE_RANGE：使用HLS规范中的EXT-X-DATERANGE标记，端点协议为HLS/HLS_CMAF时可用
XML：使用DASH规范中的XML广告标记，端点协议为DASH可用

DateTimeInterval.description_en: The interval (in seconds) for inserting the EXT-X-PROGRAM-DATE-TIME time tag. By default, the tag is not inserted. Valid values: 1 to 3600. This parameter applies to the HLS/HLS_CMAF protocol
DateTimeInterval.description_zh: 插入时间标签EXT-X-PROGRAM-DATE-TIME的间隔（秒）。默认不插入标签。取值范围：1～3600。适用HLS/HLS_CMAF协议

ManifestDuration.description_en: The maximum time-shift duration during live streaming. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 3600. Default value: 60. This parameter applies to DASH
ManifestDuration.description_zh: 直播过程中最大回看时长。单位：秒。取值范围：1～3600，默认60。适用DASH

MaxVideoBitrate.description_en: The maximum input bitrate threshold (unit: bit/s). A video track must have a bitrate less than or equal to this threshold to be played from this endpoint. Valid values: integers greater than 0. By default, this parameter is empty and no maximum bitrate limit is set
MaxVideoBitrate.description_zh: 输入最大比特率阈值（单位：比特/秒），视频轨道必须小于等于此阈值才能从此端点播放。取值范围：大于0的整数。默认为空不限制最大比特率

MinBufferTime.description_en:
The minimum buffer time. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 30. Default value: 2 segment durations. This parameter applies only to DASH.

An excessively small minimum buffer time may cause playback stuttering. Set this parameter to a value no less than 2 segment durations
MinBufferTime.description_zh:
最小缓冲时间，单位：秒。取值范围：1～30。默认2个切片时长。仅适用DASH。

注意：最小缓冲时间过小可能导致播放卡顿，建议不小于2个切片时长

MinUpdatePeriod.description_en:
The minimum update interval. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 3600. Default value: 2 segment durations. This parameter applies to DASH.

Set this parameter to a value less than the minimum buffer time. An excessively large value may cause DASH playback stuttering
MinUpdatePeriod.description_zh:
最小更新间隔。单位：秒。取值范围：1～3600。默认2个切片时长。适用DASH。

注意：建议设置为小于最小缓冲时间，过大会导致DASH播放卡顿

MinVideoBitrate.description_en: The minimum input bitrate threshold (unit: bit/s). A video track must have a bitrate greater than or equal to this threshold to be played from this endpoint. Valid values: integers greater than 0. By default, this parameter is empty and no minimum bitrate is set
MinVideoBitrate.description_zh: 输入最小比特率阈值（单位：比特/秒），视频轨道必须大于或者等于此阈值才能从此端点播放。取值范围：大于0的整数。默认为空不设置最小比特率

PresentationDelay.description_en: The suggested presentation delay. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 60. Default value: 3 segment durations
PresentationDelay.description_zh: 建议启播延迟，单位：秒。取值范围：1～60。默认3个切片时长

SegmentCount.description_en: The number of segments. This parameter applies to the HLS/HLS_CMAF protocol. By default, the channel configuration is used. Valid values: 2 to 100
SegmentCount.description_zh: 切片个数，适用HLS/HLS_CMAF协议，默认使用channel的配置，取值范围：2～100

SegmentTemplateFormat.description_en: The segment template. Currently, only NUMBER_TIMELINE (default) is supported. This parameter applies to DASH
SegmentTemplateFormat.description_zh: 切片模版，暂只支持NUMBER_TIMELINE（默认）。适用DASH

StreamOrder.description_en:
The stream sorting rule. Valid values:
ORIGINAL: retains the original order of the input sub-manifest.
VIDEO_BITRATE_ASCENDING: sorts by video stream bitrate in ascending order.
VIDEO_BITRATE_DESCENDING: sorts by video stream bitrate in descending order
StreamOrder.description_zh:
流排序规则，支持值：
ORIGINAL：保持输入的子清单排序；
VIDEO_BITRATE_ASCENDING：按视频流码率递增；
VIDEO_BITRATE_DESCENDING：按视频流码率递减

DrmConfig.description_en: The DRM encryption provider configuration. If encryption is not required, leave all fields empty
DrmConfig.description_zh: DRM加密提供商配置，如不加密，所有字段留空

ContentId.description_en: The content ID in the DRM system. Format: [A-Za-z0-9_-]+. Maximum length: 256 characters. Ensure that the content ID is unique. Otherwise, DRM playback may fail
ContentId.description_zh: DRM系统中的内容ID，格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+，长度最多256。客户需确保内容ID的唯一性，否则DRM播放可能失败

EncryptionMethod.description_en:
The encryption algorithm. Valid values:
SAMPLE_AES

Default value: empty, which indicates no encryption
EncryptionMethod.description_zh:
加密算法，支持值：
SAMPLE_AES

默认为空，即不加密
EncryptionMethod.title:
加密算法，支持值：
- AES_128
- SAMPLE_AES

IV.description_en: An optional 128-bit (16-byte) hexadecimal value represented by a 32-character string. This value is used together with the key to encrypt data blocks. If you do not specify this value, MediaPackage creates a constant initialization vector (IV). Default value: empty. If specified, the value is passed through to the provider as a constant initialization vector
IV.description_zh: 一个可选的128位（16字节）十六进制值，由32个字符的字符串表示，与密钥一起用于加密数据块。如果您不指定该值，则MediaPackage将创建一个常量初始化向量（IV）。默认值：空，如果填写，则透传到供应商Constant initialization vector
IV.title: 一个可选的128位（16字节）十六进制值，由32个字符的字符串表示，与密钥一起用于加密数据块。如果您不指定该值，则MediaPackage将创建一个常量初始化向量（IV）。默认值：空，如果填写，则透传到供应商Constant initialization vector。

RotatePeriod.description_en: The DRM key rotation interval. Unit: seconds. Default value: 0, which indicates that key rotation is disabled
RotatePeriod.description_zh: DRM密钥轮转间隔，单位：秒。默认为0，密钥不轮换
RotatePeriod.title: DRM key轮转间隔，单位：秒

SystemIds.description_en:
The DRM system IDs, determined by the protocol type.
DASH: supports Google Widevine and Microsoft PlayReady.
HLS: not supported.
HLS_CMAF: supports Apple FairPlay, Google Widevine, and Microsoft PlayReady.

Three DRM systems are supported: Apple FairPlay, Google Widevine, and Microsoft PlayReady. The corresponding system IDs are:

94ce86fb-07ff-4f43-adb8-93d2fa968ca2
Google Widevine:
edef8ba9-79d6-4ace-a3c8-27dcd51d21ed
Microsoft PlayReady:
9a04f079-9840-4286-ab92-e65be0885f95

HLS -- 暂不支持

9a04f079-9840-4286-ab92-e65be0885f95

drm 系统id，system id数量由使用的协议类型决定。
- DASH -- 最多两个

SegmentDuration.description_en: The duration of each segment, in seconds. Default value: the channel segment duration. The actual segment duration is the nearest multiple of the source segment duration that is greater than or equal to the configured value. Valid values: 1 to 30
SegmentDuration.description_zh: 每个切片的时长（以秒为单位），默认为频道切片时长。实际切片时长为最接近源片段时长的倍数，大于等于配置值。取值范围【1，30】
SegmentDuration.title: 每个片段的时长（以秒为单位）。实际片段将会被四舍五入到最接近的源片段时长的倍数。取值范围【1，30】。

UseAudioRenditionGroups.description_en: Specifies whether to separate audio tracks in TS segments
UseAudioRenditionGroups.title: TS切片是否分离音频轨

description_en: Adds an origin endpoint configuration for a live streaming channel. This operation supports HLS, HLS_CMAF, and DASH protocols and DRM encryption
description_zh: 用于添加实时流媒体频道的源站端点配置，支持HLS、HLS_CMAF和DASH协议及DRM加密
kebab_example: aliyun ice create-live-package-origin-endpoint --group-name channel-group-1 --channel-name channel-1 --endpoint-name endpoint-1 --protocol HLS --manifest-name manifest --description This_is_an_origin_endpoint. --timeshift-vision 1 --authorization-code AbcDef123 --ip-whitelist 192.168.1.0/24,10.0.0.1/24 --ip-blacklist 103.21.222.1/32,192.168.100.0/24 --client-token 00000311a423d11a5f7dee7135350000 --live-packaging-config example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLivePackageOriginEndpoint
